item.tib: drin chen bla ma'i sgrub pa las tshe sgrub bdud rtsi'i zil thig
item.coloph: zhes skyabs gnas spyi 'dus drin can bla ma'i sgrab pa bsam 'phel nor bu'i phreng ba las/ 'chi med tshe ru sgrub pa'i ti ka bdud rtsi zil thigs 'di yang / skad gnyis smra ba'i lo tse mkhas pa rin chen blo gsal gyi gar rol/ skyang (spyang) bla rin po che mnyam med tshul khrims dbang grags mchog gis bka' gsungs spyi bor phebs pa dang*/ ma zad mkhas pa'i nor la dbang zhing rigs mthun snying gi grogs po tshul khrims blo gros nas/ rten 'brel legs mtshon spyi blug dang lha rdzas dar dkar gyis sna drangs nas bskul ba la brten nas/ rgod rje'i rus thob skyabs gnas 'dus gtso drin chen bla ma de nyid nyin snang mtshan 'khrul sogs la skad gcigs(cig) gi snang ba dang mi 'bral ba'i zog po te (gte) rgan tshe dbang bde chen snying po'am g.yung drung grags pa bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dbang gi rgyal por 'bod pa'i sprang phrug phal pa ci lta ba des/ drin chen bla ma de nyid mdun du bzhugs par byas nas skyo gdung gi snang ba dang bcas te/ dpal ldan nor bu gling gi ri khrod kun bzang bde chen pho brang du/ snang ba lam khyer 'od gsal grogs su shar ba'i thun mtshams la spel ba 'dis kyang / tshe bdud rang sar grol nas mi shig g.yung drung gi sku ru brnyes pa'i rgyu ru gyur cig/
